role: Two radar charts side by side for current and future capability profiles
takeaway: Use this fixed-geometry composition to organize an illustrative modernization-planning discussion; all decisions and metrics require client validation.

components.semantic_purpose: Two radar charts side by side for current and future capability profiles. Non-text diagrams, imagery, data marks, and logo remain preserved.

slot_notes.title: Title for this semantic region; exact source bindings retained.
slot_notes.current_profile_label: Current profile label for this semantic region; exact source bindings retained.
slot_notes.target_profile_label: Target profile label for this semantic region; exact source bindings retained.

style_notes: Chart series colors are source-themed: current-state series uses accent1 = F900D3; future-state series uses accent5 = 00E8FA.
Current-state legend swatches are source connector objects 15 and their line uses fill.schemeClr.val = tx2, resolving to 0047FF. Future-state connector objects 17 use accent5 and remain cyan.

The component profile API permits only explicit fill.srgbClr.val bindings. Both legend swatches expose scheme-color bindings, so a bounded current-series legend RGB role cannot be declared without changing shared code or source representation.
opaque_areas: Both radar plots, polygon outlines, axis labels, rating values, and series geometry are opaque chart artwork and retain source assessments.
retained_source_content: The two radar plots, axis labels, values, and series remain the source chart artwork; chart data and profile labels are not editable text. Example labels remain short to fit the two legend positions.
limitations: Fixed text-binding cardinality and opaque source charts; chart values and geometry remain unchanged.
Current-state legend swatches are blue while their retained chart series is magenta; the mismatch remains open because scheme-color connectors are outside the existing profile API.
Current example was natively rendered in evidence v2; this metadata does not qualify arbitrary content fit or adaptation.
